divergences.old: create-repo, create-pr and create-prs repeating the group's --project (and create-pr's --repo) as their own flags, which won over the group's
divergences.toil: --project and --repo are the group's context inputs and are accepted in the same places, before or after the command (toil bitbucket create-pr --project ~jdoe ...). Given twice, once on each side, they are one flag, so the last value wins rather than the command's
divergences.why: Where a command acts is one context input per area, resolved by core from the call, then the connection (CLAUDE.md, Layout); a second flag of the same name would be a second, unreported source.

divergences.old: Every command reading --project and --repo from the git remote (origin or any other) when neither the flags nor defaults.bitbucket gave them
divergences.toil: Not yet: project and repo come from --project and --repo, then the connection's project and repo settings (defaults.bitbucket). The remote step returns once core's git reader can see the connection's base URL, which the remote parser needs to trust only a remote on that host
divergences.why: Without the base URL, a remote on any host (a GitHub clone's git@github.com:owner/repo) would be read as a Bitbucket project and repo, ahead of the connection's own settings.

divergences.old: "Could not determine Bitbucket project/repo. Pass --project and --repo, or run <old CLI> config init." (and the project-only form for create-repo and create-prs)
divergences.toil: The same first sentence, then "or set project and repo on the connection", with a fix naming the env vars; checked by core before the command runs, so for list-prs it comes before a bad --created-after is reported
divergences.why: toil has no config init; an error must point at something the user can do.

divergences.old: list-prs, list-comments paging until isLastPage is true, stepping by start + limit when a page has no nextPageStart, with no limit on the number of pages
divergences.toil: Paging stops when isLastPage is true or a page has no nextPageStart, and after 1,000 pages (100,000 items) fails with HTTP naming the list and a fix to narrow it
divergences.why: A server that never says isLastPage would otherwise be read forever; Bitbucket sends nextPageStart on every page that isn't the last.

divergences.old: create-prs recording a timeout or cancel as an error for the repository it hit, then carrying on
divergences.toil: A timeout (TOIL_TIMEOUT_MS) or cancel ends the run with TIMEOUT or CANCELLED, which says pull requests may already have been created
divergences.why: Once toil has stopped waiting, every remaining request would fail the same way, and a write's timeout has to say the change may have been made.
